test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of the e-Zero FIR initiative launched by the Union Ministry of Home Affairs in May 2025?

options.text: Provide compensation for cyber fraud victims
Launch an online cyber safety portal

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fast-track cyber fraud FIRs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **e-Zero FIR initiative** was launched by the **Union Ministry of Home Affairs** in **May 2025**.
 
• The primary aim of this initiative is to **fast-track the filing of First Information Reports (FIRs)** related to **cyber fraud cases**.
 
• It seeks to address the growing concerns of **cybercrime victims** by providing a **streamlined and efficient process** for registering FIRs.
 
• This initiative integrates with the **National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal**, allowing victims to file complaints online without needing to visit a police station physically.
 
• The system aims to **reduce delays** in registering FIRs and ensure that victims receive timely assistance.
 
• The e-Zero FIR system leverages **digital platforms and technology** to address the **increasing incidents of cyber fraud** in India.
 
• It also facilitates coordination between **law enforcement agencies** across states, ensuring quicker investigation and resolution of cybercrime cases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Provide compensation for cyber fraud victims**__

 __
 
• This option refers to the provision of **monetary compensation** to victims who have suffered losses due to cyber fraud.
 
• While compensation is an important aspect of addressing cybercrime, the **e-Zero FIR initiative** primarily focuses on **fast-tracking FIR registration** rather than directly compensating victims.
 
 
 
• **Launch an online cyber safety portal**__
 __
 
• This option refers to creating a platform to **promote cyber safety awareness** and provide guidelines to prevent cybercrime.
 
• Although similar initiatives exist, the **e-Zero FIR system** specifically targets the process of registering cyber fraud FIRs.
 
 
 
• **Create a national crime database**__
 
 
• This option refers to the establishment of a centralized repository of **criminal records and crime statistics**.
 
• While such a database could aid in tracking and investigating crimes, the **e-Zero FIR initiative** is focused on the **registration of cyber fraud cases**.
